finding: Independent evidence identifies the item as the Gine (DB Super) Set accessory, separate from Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes.

evidence.finding: Dragon Ball Wiki states that the Gine (DB Super) Set accessory and Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes set can be randomly obtained in New Parallel Quest 144, Super 17's Super Plan.
Independent Dragon Ball Wiki mirror explicitly distinguishes the Gine (DB Super) Set accessory from the four-piece Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes equipment set and associates both with PQ144.
Current equipment documentation lists Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes as a four-piece clothing set acquired from PQ144, while accessories are a separate equipment category.

Independent ID documentation records 781 as Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes and 781 as the Gine (DB Super) Set accessory in the notes, supporting the existence of a distinct accessory/set identity rather than a clothing-piece alias.

identity_boundary: The evidence is sufficient to reject treating the research label as Gine (DB Super)'s Clothes.
